result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant title is truncated and visually broken.

issues.description: The restaurant name under 'Popular right now' displays as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final letter cut off, despite being on a full-width card with space available next to the rating.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title container width, flex layout, or truncation/ellipsizing logic so the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is visible without clipping.
